# Unions with intersection members are skipped (done = false), and unions
# whose members contain intersections are reconstituted as they are and
# need another pass.
builder
prim i integer
str s unrestricted
obj a x:i - n=A
obj b y:s - n=B
inter x a,b n=X
union u x,s n=WithIntersection
union nested u,i n=Nested
union plain i,s n=Plain
uunion v n=V
members v plain,i
arr av v
union w av,s n=W
cls top u:u,n:nested,w:w n=Top
top Top top
finish
flatten debug
print
resolve
print
flatten
print
resolve
flatten
print
